negative_controls_registered.name: matched_gene_sets
negative_controls_registered.description: Matched random gene sets (same mean expression / variance) must NOT systematically reproduce the disease map; the true gene-set rho should lie in the far right tail of the matched-null distribution.

negative_controls_registered.name: cross_disease_gene_sets
negative_controls_registered.description: Each unrelated disease gene set (PD genes vs AD map, HD genes vs AD map, etc.) should produce systematically weaker spatial correspondence than the matched disease gene set.

negative_controls_registered.name: unrelated_phenotype_map
negative_controls_registered.description: An explicitly unrelated parcellated phenotype map supplied under data/external/negative_controls/ should show no robust correspondence with the disease molecular map.
